Two versions of the definition

Yours unsaved

Uplift is applied to the base volume after seasonality but before channel mix, so a change to the mix does not compound into the uplift. This matches how the planning team has always described it in workshops, and it is the reading the current spreadsheet implements.

d.xing · edited 09:41 · against version 7

Published in force

Uplift is applied after channel mix, so the two interact. This is what the model actually computes today, and it is why the Q2 reforecast moved when the mix was corrected. If the definition above is the intended behaviour, the model is wrong rather than the definition.

a.okafor · published 12 Jun · version 7
